name: plan-runner
description: Execute Markdown plans as dependency-ready task DAGs with isolated Git worktrees, independent verification, durable recovery evidence, and human-reviewed PR delivery. Requires Git.

interface.shortDescription: Execute plans as verified task DAGs
interface.longDescription: Analyze a Markdown plan into a dependency-ready task graph, run each ready task in its own disposable Git worktree with test-first and implementation agents, gate every task with deterministic checks and independent verification before a central integrator applies it to a run-owned branch, checkpoint durable task state for resume, aggregate bugs into a re-runnable fix plan, and open a human-reviewed pull request. Requires a Git repository with usable worktrees.
defaultPrompt: Run this implementation plan with Plan Runner.
Execute this plan as a task DAG with per-task verification.
Open a pull request for this completed Plan Runner cycle.
